text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A short while after the Debut races 
concluded— The announcement of the 
"U.A.F." was made, leaving the public 
largely perplexed and bewildered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around that time, Sonnet Elf and the 
others ask <chrname> to appear in a promotional 
video for the "U.A.F."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume can shine in sports other than 
racing too. Driven to prove this to the 
world, she threw her heart into PR 
activities to hype up the tournament.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the video, they compete against Sonnet 
Elfie in 15 different events. Faced with 
her overwhelming physical prowess, <chrname> is 
left far behind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking the identified areas for 
improvement into account while stepping up 
training, we'll do our best toward the 
success of the 'U.A.F.'—our resolve was 
renewed once more.
